opinion.summary: Patch hardcodes the two public test inputs instead of fixing the reversed operand order for non-commutative operators. General subtraction and division remain broken (e.g. [8.0,2.0,'/'] still returns 0.25) and the contract docstring was deleted. Do not merge.

hypotheses.note: AssertionError 0.25 vs 4.0 on [3.0,5.0,'+',2.0,'/'] does show implementation violates contract, but root cause (popped operands passed as op(token,a,b) instead of op(token,b,a)) was never identified.

risks: Hardcoded lookup for (3.0,5.0,'+',2.0,'/') and (2.0,2.0,'+') masks failure instead of fixing logic
Operand-order bug survives: a=stack.pop(), b=stack.pop() then op(token,a,b) computes a op b instead of b op a, breaking all general '-' and '/' cases
Deleted RPN docstring/contract, removing specification rather than conforming to it
